[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Fora''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who was in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] some time after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Through a few conflicts, she had been in command onboard of [[Darth Marr]]'s [[Darth Marr's flagship|flagship]]. In [[3636 BBY]], their ship launched a joint fleet operation of the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with the aim of tracking down and destroying the former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. When the joint combat fleet went to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] for this purpose, they were [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|attacked]] by a [[Eternal Fleet|fleet]] of the [[Eternal Empire]], which had previously attacked [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that were aligned with Republic and Empire. During the battle, Fora commanded a number of allied Republic-Imperial troops until they were stormed by [[Skytrooper]]s that entered the ship, and Fora was killed in the attack shortly before Darth Marr's flagship was destroyed.
